profile.headline: Software Engineer | Software Architect | Entrepreneur | Electrical Engineer | Big-dreamer
profile.summary:
I am a programming enthusiast and have experience in the Web and Embedded software development. I have worked with Web Development frameworks such as Django, Flask, google app engine. Embedded experience includes working on a real-time embedded system, IoT, robotics, and networking.

My experience as a software developer has provided me the opportunity to work on the critical and complexed system. The experience that I have gained, helped me to possess skills and to embed different programming languages as a programmer.

If you have ideas for a startup or business or have any opportunities, feel free to reach out to me.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Architected and managed a project of digital signage following agile methodology

- Led the project of VoIP (IP phone) system which is integrated/configured with the portal and includes the functionalities such as; calling, voicemail, call parking, shared line appearance, stutter tone, IVR, auto dial, busy tone, fall-back, SIP/IAX trunk, intercom

- Engineering custom build of OpenWRT/LEDE (Linux-distro), the custom environment of Ubuntu

- Developing the multithreaded program to control the third party devices using HTTP/REST API and TCP/UDP protocol

- Programmed the device to switch between network interface(such as Ethernet, Wifi, and cellular), which has increased 70% network reliability of the device

- Cross-compiled the code to work on AR9331, QCA9531, ARM (Raspberry PI) and Intel J1900
processor

- Integrated the cellular module(3G/LTE) using pppd in Linux environment and wrote a shell script for the wifi connectivity, and network scanning

- Wrote a backend for the local static page of IoT devices and hosting using uHTTPd

- Enhanced signaling system and created a logging system using object-oriented programming

- Developed a script (Python) to communicate with motion package and upload video clips to AWS S3

- Working on the backend (Ruby on Rails) for generating dynamic configuration files for the IoT device based on user's selections

- Configured the AWS server for video analytics application

projects.title: Catalog App (sports'​ data)
projects.description:
- Developed a RESTful web application using Flask along with implementing third-party OAuth authentication. 

- Mapped HTTP method to relate and implement CRUD operations. 

- This web application will allow user to login through google+ or Facebook account and provides features of adding, deleting and editing for sports, leagues and teams. 

- This project is currently hosted on heroku.

Github: 
https://github.com/bittu072/ItemCatalog-Sport

projects.title: Multi User Blog
projects.description:
- Built a multi-user blog using python, html and css with comments, likes, signup and login functionality

- This web app is hosted on Google App Engine and operated data with Google Cloud Datastore

Github: 
https://github.com/bittu072/multiuser-blog-website
